readerCopy.body: Stress can send a situation back toward the habit that calms things fastest even when that habit keeps rebuilding the same problem. When the Moon squares the North Node, comfort and forward movement create friction, making an old routine, relationship pattern, or emotional response especially attractive at the moment a different response is needed. Familiar relief may still help tonight without becoming the plan for the next six months. The useful clue is the need the old habit meets and how that need can travel forward without restoring everything attached to it.
